mapper.select: select answer_error.user_error_type_id, user_error_type.name as user_error_type_name, user_error_type.status as user_error_type_status, error_type.id as error_type_id, error_type.code as error_type_code, case when #{learningMode} = 'EN_TO_JA' then error_type.name_en else error_type.name end as error_type_name, count(1) as confirmed_count, count(*) filter (where answer_error.severity = 'LOW') as low_severity_count, count(*) filter (where answer_error.severity = 'MEDIUM') as medium_severity_count, count(*) filter (where answer_error.severity = 'HIGH') as high_severity_count, max(answer_error.created_at) as last_confirmed_at, review_card.status as review_card_status, review_card.due_at as review_card_due_at from user_answer_errors answer_error inner join user_answers user_answer on user_answer.id = answer_error.user_answer_id and user_answer.user_id = #{userId} and user_answer.deleted = false and user_answer.learning_mode = #{learningMode} inner join user_error_types user_error_type on user_error_type.id = answer_error.user_error_type_id and user_error_type.user_id = #{userId} and user_error_type.learning_mode = #{learningMode} inner join error_types error_type on error_type.id = answer_error.error_type_id left join review_cards review_card on review_card.user_error_type_id = user_error_type.id and review_card.user_id = #{userId} and review_card.deleted = false where answer_error.user_id = #{userId} and answer_error.created_at >= #{startAt} and answer_error.created_at < #{endAt} group by answer_error.user_error_type_id, user_error_type.name, user_error_type.status, error_type.id, error_type.code, error_type.name, error_type.name_en, review_card.status, review_card.due_at order by confirmed_count desc, last_confirmed_at desc, answer_error.user_error_type_id desc limit 10

select count(*) filter (where review_card.status = 'ACTIVE' and review_card.due_at <= #{now}) as due_card_count, count(*) filter (where review_card.status = 'ACTIVE') as active_card_count, count(*) filter (where review_card.status = 'MASTERED') as mastered_card_count from review_cards review_card inner join user_error_types user_error_type on user_error_type.id = review_card.user_error_type_id and user_error_type.status = 'ACTIVE' and user_error_type.learning_mode = #{learningMode} where review_card.user_id = #{userId} and review_card.deleted = false
